prompt: Pixelated low-resolution 16-bit pixel art, a flat 2D seamless repeating texture of packed desert sandstone seen exactly head-on like a scanned sheet, with no depth, no floor and no viewing angle; the stone fills the whole picture edge to edge and continues off all four sides. Three-to-four step shading ramps lit from the top-left, hard-edged pixels, warm saturated limited palette of rust orange, sand gold, cream and umber, uniform all-over pattern with no focal point.
